TOPS Metro Tracker

tops-scanner — proof-of-concept PWA for scanning and tracking textile Metros (carts / bins) through clean and soiled lifecycle states. Runs client-side with IndexedDB for demos.

Demo one-pager
Open live app TOPS on GitHub

What it demonstrates

  • Metro Scan — barcode/QR camera, NFC (Web NFC + iOS URL tags), RFID keyboard wedge; workflow actions per state.
  • Orders — create work orders; expand an order to scan/link metros without leaving the tab.
  • Metros & dashboard — stat cards filter the metro list; expandable rows show scan history; RFID EPC → metro aliases stored locally.
  • Inventory & locations — read-only views over seeded demo data.

Metro lifecycle workflow

Typical state transitions enforced in the POC (clean delivery on top, soiled return and plant loop below). Arrows show the main progression.

Scan channels

Camerahtml5-qrcode — barcodes & QR. Needs HTTPS or localhost.
NFCWeb NFC (Android) or NTAG URL → ?metro= (iOS).
RFIDBluetooth HID wedge; optional EPC → metro mapping in IndexedDB.

Tech stack

Single-page app (this file is static HTML; the product is React + Vite).

React 18 TypeScript Vite 5 vite-plugin-pwa IndexedDB (idb) html5-qrcode lucide-react

Run locally

From tops-scanner: npm install → npm run dev → open the app URL. This page: /demo-presentation.html.
